prompt: <image1> shows a creature at its adult stage. Draw the same creature grown into its elder stage. Body change: the whole silhouette changes into a wide low dome like a gentle giant tortoise crossed with a bison: the body becomes much wider than tall, the four legs become short thick pillars, the head is carried low in front, and a big rounded sand-colored shell dome covers the whole back, carrying a tiny moss garden with two round shrubs; the mossy mane becomes a soft collar. Keep from <image1>: the face with its eyes, small mouth and coral cheeks, wide rounded leaf-shaped ears that hang slightly sideways, and a cream blaze running from the nose up over the forehead, the apricot and cream colors and the flat two-tone style without outlines. One creature, full body, three-quarter front view, plain flat pale mint background.
